Session history; not necessarily an audio transcription

semantic_scope: Maximum inactive gap awaiting headers/body chunks, not total execution deadline. disabled maps to timeoutMs 0; do not infer that external work stopped.

avoid: 無料のキャッシュ更新

Decision governing trust in project resources. Default applies only if no extension or saved decision decides; ask/always/never IDs remain exact and never-trust negation must survive.

Terminal alternate-screen layout, distinct from regular scrollback layout. Translate prose only; fullscreen/regular and setting values remain exact. Deployed フルスクリーン differs; actual recorded in reconciliation.
Horizontal display spacing for editor/messages/output; does not modify file contents or message text. Preserve allowed numeric ranges.
Provider account/subscription authentication distinct from API keys and non-subscription accounts. Paid extra usage warning retains possible extra-charge risk; it is not a billing toggle.

preferred_ja: プレビュー上だけの警告 / 警告
semantic_scope: Display-only risk notice in code previews; neither blocks execution nor certifies safety. Possible secret matches remain possibilities, not confirmed leaks; distinguish this from actual tool/source errors.
avoid: ブロック済み; 安全を確認済み

semantic_scope: Existing AWS SDK credential resolution chain, distinct from saved bearer token or saved profile name. Ambient credentials are not automatically copied into Pi storage.

preferred_ja: アプリケーションのデフォルト認証情報
semantic_scope: Named Google Cloud authentication method. Proposal intentionally uses the service-specific Japanese method name rather than shared default=既定 and credential=資格情報; generic credential prose still uses 資格情報. Requires central terminology reconciliation, not a glossary-policy change.
avoid: 単なる既定の API キー

preferred_ja: セッションツリー / 分岐
semantic_scope: Tree of session entries and conversation branches, or threaded session-parent list as context specifies. Not a Git branch. Label removal removes a label only; branch navigation is not deletion.

Optional summary when navigating session branches. Distinguish choice cancellation, summary abortion, and navigation cancellation. Model-generated summary and user instructions are content, not translated UI.

preferred_ja: 折りたたみ時 / 展開した / 非表示の行
semantic_scope: Preview display states, not output destruction or tool cancellation. Expansion may show more retained output but cannot recover output already truncated by the tool. Counts/nouns require a Japanese formatter instead of English suffix pluralization.
Shiki coloring of retained code/output. A skip notice for large data does not mean read/write/edit failed or content is missing. Language/theme IDs and actual code remain unchanged.

english: diff; proposed edit; applied edit; hunk
preferred_ja: 差分 / 編集案 / 適用した編集 / 差分ブロック
semantic_scope: Preview of proposed or actual changes; keep proposed and applied distinct. Hunk is a contiguous changed group, not a file. Skipping diff rendering does not mean skipping the file mutation; underlying diff text remains exact.

preferred_ja: 経過時間 / 所要時間
semantic_scope: Running elapsed duration versus fixed final duration of tool execution. Completion timing is not a success assertion. Technical duration units and value formatting stay unchanged.

semantic_scope: Generic configuration data/file is translated even when English source begins with capital Settings. Only the named Jouzu Palette view Settings is protected.

avoid: Settings / Catalogs in Japanese route prose

semantic_scope: Render-time ownership permits native labels to translate; third-party/user/provider content, model IDs, errors, URLs and paths remain exact. Prototype/item restoration is not persistence rollback.
